crossRefs.note: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,
For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.

translations.web: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,
translations.bsb: calling out to those who pass by, who make their paths straight.
translations.kjv: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
translations.asv: To call to them that pass by, Who go right on their ways:
